basic_info.description: Welcome to 745-747 26th Avenue, a fully rebuilt (2006) two-unit condo building in the heart of the Richmond. Situated on an extra-wide 30' x 120' lot, the property features timeless details including oak wood floors, crown molding, high ceilings, custom windows, and abundant natural light throughout. Amenities include a two-car side-by-side garage with 8' ceiling heights and low-maintenance yard.  Unit 745 is a dual-level home with 5 bedrooms + den and 3.5 bathrooms. The main level offers an open living/dining area, kitchen with premium stainless-steel appliances, 3 bedrooms and 2 baths including a primary suite with spa-style bath with Jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanity. In-unit laundry closet.  The lower level features a family room, 2 bedrooms, a den, a full bath and a half bath.  Unit 747 is a spacious single-level flat with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, an open living/dining area, kitchen with premium stainless-steel appliances, and a primary suite with Jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanity. In-unit laundry room with sink.  Approved and zoned as 2 condominiums, this property offers flexibility for multigenerational living or investment. Walk to Golden Gate Park, public transit, restaurants and shops. Great location! Must see to appreciate!
